scope: Completed seven-method screen and both predeclared worker controls; confirmation definition only. No maximum replay or confirmation outcomes are included.

execution.environment_scope: Exact RAYON_NUM_THREADS is retained in each run record; original argv/log/resource records are preserved. No timing inference from confirmation or concurrent maximum replay.
execution.worker_criterion: Choose 30 only if 2048/Integrate-time throughput ratio >=1.35 and peak RSS <=300000000000 bytes; otherwise 20. Integrate time includes warmup. This decision preceded advanced statistics.

selection.score_rule: minimum worst normalized4-observable sample variance; exact ties use declared order; b has identical soft policy

statistics.limits: Empirical fixed-N screening; the 0.03947% composed/direct score separation is not evidence of superiority. Component extrema do not establish a bound or identify the largest complex-norm sample.

confirmation.status: Definition frozen before confirmation results; the unmodified manifest retains preparation-time status/prose.

archive_convention.logical_paths: artifact_hashes.json maps original path and logical archive name to exact uncompressed bytes and stored_path; repeated identical files share storage, including references to prior immutable archives. All four original frozen directory trees can be reconstructed separately, without inventing an aggregate workspace.
archive_convention.hashes: SHA256 and byte counts refer to uncompressed original content; gzip copies are byte-preserving. No generated-process saved-state payload or executable is copied.
archive_convention.script_replay: The independent audit.py is preserved unchanged and uses original absolute paths; restore files according to original_path in an isolated environment to replay it. The production analyzer accepts the three actual directories; no statistical formula was added for this archive.
